call_points.text: Management targets 20-25% volume CAGR and 30-35% profitability growth under Vision 2030.
No division-wise volume guidance for FY27; management said quarter-to-quarter volume growth may fall short of earlier expectations.
Total installed capacity is 4.97 lakh tpa, targeted above 8 lakh tpa by FY29.
Rubber capacity put on hold; plant and machinery earmarked for it is being redirected to fast-track copper.
LME brand listing for Mundra lead under GRAVITA M makes product deliverable at LME warehouses; no product sold on LME.
ICRA upgraded long-term rating to AA from AA-.
A 6,000 MTPA lithium-ion battery recycling plant at Mundra was commissioned in FY26.
Mundra lead capacity rose by 80,300 MTPA to 1,45,100 MTPA.
Orderbook stands at 60,000 MT+ with 70% capacity utilisation, excluding recent expansions.
Value-added products are targeted at ~45-50% of the mix and non-lead at ~35-40%.
External credit rating is AA- from ICRA and India Ratings.
Procurement runs through 39 own yards and 2,200+ touch points collecting 3,30,000 MT+ of scrap.

deals.segment: recycling capacity across lead, copper, lithium-ion and steel

guidance.statement: Capex plan of ₹375 Cr in FY27 and ₹380 Cr in FY28
PAT CAGR of 25-30% this year and for the next four to five years
Copper EBITDA per tonne to rise to about ₹60,000 by end of FY27 and ₹75,000 in 2-2.5 years
Copper capacity to double to about 60,000 tpa in three years
Total capacity to scale above 8 lakh tpa by FY29
Total capex of ₹1,680 Cr through FY29, of which ₹850 Cr for existing businesses

industry: Commodities > Metals & Mining > Minerals & Mining > Industrial Minerals

operating_notes.text: Copper segment, new after the Rashtriya Metal Industries acquisition, contributed ₹51.78 Cr of Q4FY26 revenue and ₹2.42 Cr of segment result.
Lead segment revenue was ₹1,000.36 Cr in Q4FY26 with segment result of ₹107.67 Cr, against ₹911.55 Cr and ₹114.13 Cr a year earlier.
A customs demand of ₹70.10 Cr (excluding interest, fine and penalty) is under appeal; management expects no material impact.
FY26 capacity utilisation was 70%, excluding recent capacity expansions.
Orderbook stood at 60,000 MT+ as on 07.05.2026.
RMIL operates a 31,200 MTPA copper and alloy facility at Sarigram, Gujarat, with FY26 revenue of ₹1,040 Cr and EBITDA of ₹82 Cr.
Planned to set up a copper recycling plant at Mandvi, Gujarat, with ~29,400 MTPA capacity and ~₹160 Cr capex funded through internal accruals.
Phagi lead unit existing capacity 35,319 MTPA, close to full utilisation; ~42,000 MTPA addition targeted by end-June 2026 at ~₹30 Cr from internal accruals.
Total installed capacity reached about 4.57 lakh MTPA in FY26.
Bank loan facilities of ₹150 Cr reaffirmed at IND AA-/Stable/IND A1+ by India Ratings.
Group capacity utilisation was about 52% in Q1FY27, with Mundra at about 50% and Jaipur lead at about 45%.
Domestic sourcing was about 35% of India plant requirements in Q1FY27; 15-20% of scrap imports come from the Gulf.
Value-added products were 63% of consolidated revenue in Q1FY27, with ex-copper value-added share at 50%.
Gravita approved an additional investment of approx ₹94.42 Cr in the rights issue of its material subsidiary Rashtriya Metal Industries Limited.
Incorporated Gravita Recyclers USA Inc. in the USA for trading of scrap and scrap materials with an initial capital of USD 50,000.

timeline.summary: Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹1,172.76 Cr (+13.1% YoY), net profit ₹91.81 Cr (-3.3% YoY).
2026-05-07: Investor presentation for FY26 shows revenue ₹4,265 Cr (+10%), PAT +21%, ₹372 Cr capex, Mundra lead capacity at 1,45,100 MTPA and 99.44% of RMIL acquired for ₹561.84 Cr.
On May 7, 2026, Gravita India announced plans to set up a copper recycling plant at Mandvi, Gujarat, with an installed capacity of 29,400 MTPA and capex of ~₹160 Cr.
On May 8, 2026, Gravita India said it is adding ~42,000 MTPA to its Phagi, Jaipur lead recycling unit (existing 35,319 MTPA) for about ₹30 Cr from internal accruals, targeted by end-June 2026.
Gravita India Limited uploaded the audio recording of its earnings call for Q4FY26 and FY26 results held on May 8, 2026, via its website.
On May 8, 2026, Gravita India hosted its Q4 & FY26 earnings call, highlighting a ₹1,700 Cr capex plan through FY29 and entry into the copper segment via RML.
On May 12, 2026, India Ratings reaffirmed Gravita India's bank loan facilities at IND AA-/Stable/IND A1+.
On May 16, 2026, Gravita India announced a GST penalty of Rs. 1.66 lakh imposed by the Ghaziabad authorities.
On May 22, 2026, Gravita India participated in a one-on-one institutional investor meeting.

On its 28 July 2026 Q1FY27 call, Gravita reported revenue up 42% YoY to ₹1,475 Cr and PAT up 14% to ₹106.39 Cr, flagged a Gulf-linked lead scrap disruption spilling into Q2, and guided copper EBITDA per tonne from about ₹55,000 toward ₹75,000 over 2-2.5 years.
Gravita India approved an additional investment of ₹94.42 Cr via a rights issue in its copper manufacturing subsidiary Rashtriya Metal Industries Limited.
Gravita India incorporated Gravita Recyclers USA Inc. as a wholly owned subsidiary in the USA for scrap trading on October 16, 2026.
Board of Directors declared Interim Dividend of Rs. 7.70 per equity share, record date 3 November 2026, payment by 25 November 2026.
Gravita India released its investor presentation for H1FY27 on October 27, 2026, highlighting growth and Vision 2030 progress.

watchlist.response: Management declined to give division-wise volume guidance, citing supply disruption, and pointed to the long-term FY30 vision instead.
watchlist.text: Analyst asked twice for division-wise FY27 volume guidance after a first year-on-year decline in lead volumes.

watchlist.response: Management attributed the percentage dilution to higher LME copper prices and pointed to EBITDA per tonne, guiding to about ₹60,000 by year-end.
watchlist.text: Copper EBITDA margin fell to about 5.2% from about 8% last year; analyst asked how the gap would be bridged.

watchlist.response: Management gave a rounded figure of about ₹1,040 Cr, almost similar to March 2026, without a precise balance-sheet number.
